dedupe_keys.name: dominican republic licensed health establishments of the national health service 1878 to 2026 sns establecimientos de salud habilitados

description: This dataset lists the health establishments licensed within the Dominican Republic's National Health Service, published by the Servicio Nacional de Salud on its open data transparency page. Each row is an establishment with its name, type (for example high or medium complexity hospital, children's hospital or primary care centre), address, licensing status, level of care, regional health service, province, municipality, neighbourhood, opening year and latitude and longitude. Coverage is the national public network, with opening years from 1878 to 2026. The data are free to download as CSV, Excel or JSON from the same page, which also offers service production statistics and affiliate registration tables. Caveats: no licence is stated on the page; the list covers the public SNS network, not private clinics; some opening years are recorded as zero; and beds, staff and equipment are not given. Simulation uses: placing hospitals and clinics in hurricane, flood and earthquake exposure analyses for the Dominican Republic, computing access to care, and building healthcare nodes for Caribbean interdependency models. Related records: healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives crowd-maintained facility points and the Chile establishments register (data-chile-minsal-establecimientos-de-salud) is a comparable national list.
